rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone taking part, especially in an event, activity, or group.

example.english: Each participant in this activity has to fill out a form.
example.traditional: 呢個活動嘅每位參加者都要填表。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 ge3 mui5 wai6 caam1 gaa1 ze2 dou1 jiu3 tin4 biu2

rows.note: Use this technical term for a human enrolled in a scientific experiment or clinical trial rather than an ordinary event participant.

example.english: In the clinical trial, every participant has to sign a consent form.
example.traditional: 臨床試驗入面，每位受試者都要簽同意書。
example.jyutping: lam4 cong4 si3 jim6 jap6 min6 mui5 wai2 sau6 si3 ze2 dou1 jiu3 cim1 tung4 ji3 syu1
